slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI against approved mockup asset
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend styles for this epic, I want to adapt existing components to match design/approved/20261110013013-mockup/mockup.html, so that the knowledge base user interface achieves pixel-perfect alignment with approved design tokens and responsive layouts
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261110013013-mockup/mockup.html
When the frontend components in frontend/src/ are rendered in the browser
Then typography, color tokens, telemetry cards, and form layouts match the approved mockup specifications
Given a mobile viewport of 375px width
When navigating the responsive interface
Then horizontal overflow is eliminated and all touch targets meet minimum accessible dimensions
slices.tocConstraintRef: frontend visual styling and responsive component layout
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 visual regressions and 100% adherence to approved design mockup tokens

slices.title: Verify visual regression and accessibility compliance across viewports
slices.jtbd: When verifying UI compliance for this epic, I want to execute automated Playwright and accessibility checks, so that the approved mockup styling maintains WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast and zero layout defects across desktop and mobile journeys
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated frontend application running against the test harness
When running E2E visual regression and accessibility audit tests
Then all color combinations achieve WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast ratios (>= 7.0:1) with zero critical violations
Given desktop and mobile viewport test suites in tests/mobile-journey.spec.ts
When automated end-to-end tests are executed
Then all navigation, telemetry inspection, and search interactions pass with zero regressions
slices.tocConstraintRef: QA verification pipeline and automated cross-device visual assertion
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated test suite pass rate with 0 accessibility audit defects
